A strategic web design & development studio - Miranj Photo by Jaskaran Set your story free. Your unique story ought to be amplified. Across the barriers of space, language, gender, physical abilities, digital divide, and attention span. And etched into the memory of time. All you need are the right tools to set your story free. We enable small-biz, institutions, brands, and communication teams to organise and publish meaningful stories on the web. For their audience, but also for others who care. See our work Miranj is a strategic web design & development studio. We’re a small team distributed in India & the Netherlands, and work with a strong sense of purpose . We love to share our techniques and learnings with the community, and periodically reflect on the journey we are on. Read our blog Miranj is Anita, Prateek, Preethi, Rishi, and Souvik.

[https://miranj.in/blog]
Our blog - Miranj Our blog Page 1 of 11 Fifteen Years and Counting Mailing List Newsletter #7 Sent on Aug 2026 Hello again! Hope you’re having a pleasant day. Miranj turned fifteen in February. 🎂 It felt like the kind of milestone that deserved more than a quiet acknowledgement — and as good a reason as any to do something we’ve been meaning to do for a while: write to you again. Because yes, it has been nearly four years since our last newsletter. We have no grand excuse for the silence. Life happened, work happened, the newsletter kept getting bumped. The world hasn’t stood still in the meantime. There’s a geopolitical and economic turbulence that seems to have become the unsettling new normal. Many of us carry a low hum of anxiety through our days, and we hope you and yours are navigating it as well as can be. And then there’s AI — which has gone from fancy demos to nearly ubiquitous presence in the life of almost every knowledge worker, ourselves included. More on that shortly. Here’s everything that’s been afoot at Miranj since we last wrote. 🦋 A Renewed Sense of Purpose If you’ve known us since the 2010 s, you may have noticed the new logo and a fresh coat of paint. A decade of work brought a certain clarity about what we do best and what we value most: we’re not just a studio that builds websites — we’re long-term thinking partners for organising and publishing stories on the web. Our most fulfilling engagements haven’t been one-off projects but ongoing relationships where we help clients plan carefully, make sound decisions, and solve problems as they evolve. When that happens, the website tends to last — some of our projects have been live for 5 – 7 years, some for over 10 , which is something we’re quietly proud of. This brought us to our north star: enabling clients to communicate meaningfully on the web and preserving that knowledge over the long term . Designer, artist, and friend Kriti Monga translated this energy into a brand, and our friend (and designer) Tejas helped out with the typefaces. Our refreshed website and brand were soft-launched in February 2023 . About · Jimmy Trivedi Skip to content Jimmy Trivedi Toggle theme Menu About Jimmy Trivedi Android developer building offline-first apps that work where the network doesn't. I build Android apps in Kotlin, mostly for situations where the network cannot be trusted. That constraint shapes everything: local-first data, durable queues, and interfaces that stay useful when a request is still in flight. Most of my work has been on apps used in the field rather than in an office — health workers recording visits with no signal, passengers scanning tickets on underground platforms. The interesting problems there are rarely about the UI. They are about what the UI is allowed to assume. I care about the parts of a codebase that decide how fast it is to change later: clear module boundaries, a data layer that does not leak into the view, and tests on the logic that actually breaks. I have opinions about clean architecture, and also about when it is overkill.
